'''Karlo Matković''' (born 30 March 2001) is a Croatian professional [[basketball]] player for the [[New Orleans Pelicans]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He represents the [[Croatia men's national basketball team|Croatia national team]] internationally.

==Early career==
In 2017, Matković participated in the [[Jordan Brand Classic]] camp. In August 2018, he participated at the [[Basketball Without Borders]] Europe camp in [[Belgrade]], Serbia, representing [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Bjelica, Bogdanovic, Harris, Jokic, Kaminsky, Marjanovic and Vucevic headline Basketball Without Borders Europe 2018|url=https://www.nba.com/news/basketball-without-borders-europe-2018-official-release|website=NBA.com|date=14 August 2018|access-date=30 September 2020}}</ref>

==Professional career==
===Europe (2018–2024)===
During the [[2018–19 Premijer liga|2018–19 Croatian League]] season, Matković was promoted to the [[KK Cedevita|Cedevita]] senior team. In April 2019, he signed his first professional contract for Cedevita.<ref>{{cite web|title=Karlo Matković potpisao prvi profesionalni ugovor s Cedevitom|trans-title=Karlo Marković signed first professional contract for Cedevita|url=https://basketball.hr/vijesti/karlo-matkovic-potpisao-prvi-profesionalni-ugovor/8270|website=Basketball.hr|date=30 April 2019|access-date=30 September 2020|language=Croatian}}</ref> In September 2019, he was loaned to [[OKK Beograd]] for the [[2019–20 Basketball League of Serbia|2019–20 Serbian League season]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Veliki talent hrvatske košarke odlazi u beogradski klub|trans-title=Great talent of Croatian basketball leaves for Belgrade club|url=https://www.germanijak.hr/kosarka/vijesti/veliki-talent-hrvatske-kosarke-odlazi-u-beogradski-klub/64281|website=Germanijak.hr|date=8 August 2019|access-date=30 September 2020|language=Croatian}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Karlo Matković novi igrač OKK Beograd|trans-title=Karlo Marković OKK Belgrade's new player|url=https://sportsport.ba/kosarka/karlo-matkovic-novi-igrac-okk-beograd/328860|website=SportSport.ba|date=8 August 2019|access-date=30 September 2020|language=Croatian}}</ref> In August 2020, he was loaned to [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Soccerbet]] for the [[2020–21 ABA League First Division|2020–21 ABA season]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Karlo Matković 17 Krilni centar/Centar|trans-title=Karlo Marković 17 Wing-centre/Centre|url=https://www.bcmegabasket.net/player/karlo-matkovic/|website=BCMegabasket.net|access-date=30 September 2020|language=Croatian|archive-date=30 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201030052042/https://www.bcmegabasket.net/player/karlo-matkovic/|url-status=dead}}</ref> Following the 2020–21 season, Matković declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]], but withdrew his name from consideration on July 19, 2021.<ref>{{cite web|title=NBA announces 51 early entry candidates withdraw from 2021 Draft|url=https://www.nba.com/news/nba-announces-51-early-entry-candidates-withdraw-from-2021-draft|website=NBA.com|date=July 20, 2021|access-date=21 July 2021}}</ref>

After declaring for the [[2022 NBA draft]] in April 2022,<ref>{{cite web|title=Četvorica hrvatskih košarkaša prijavila su se za NBA draft|trans-title=Four Croatian players applied fot NBA draft|url=https://www.index.hr/sport/clanak/cetvorica-hrvatskih-kosarkasa-prijavila-su-se-za-nba-draft/2359781.aspx|website=Index.hr|date=27 April 2022|access-date=28 April 2022|language=Croatian}}</ref> Matković was selected with the 52nd overall pick by the [[New Orleans Pelicans]]<ref>{{cite news|title=New Orleans Pelicans select E.J. Liddell and Karlo Matkovic in the second round of the 2022 NBA Draft|url=https://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/ej-liddell-karlo-matkovic-2022-nba-draft-new-orleans-pelicans-second-round|website=NBA.com|date=24 June 2022|access-date=4 February 2024}}</ref> and joined them for the [[2022 NBA Summer League]].<ref>{{cite web|title=New Orleans Pelicans 2022 NBA2K23 Summer League Roster|url=https://www.nba.com/summer-league/2022/vegas/team/1610612740/pelicans|website=NBA.com|access-date=9 July 2022}}</ref> However, he didn't join the [[2022–23 New Orleans Pelicans season|Pelicans]] for the [[2022–23 NBA season]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Pelikansi odabrali Matkovića tokom reklame za slatkiše, moraće još da čeka na šansu u NBA|url=https://mozzartsport.com/kosarka/vesti/pelikansi-odabrali-matkovica-tokom-reklame-za-slatkise-morace-jos-da-ceka-na-sansu-u-nba/423455|website=MozzartSport.com|date=24 June 2022|access-date=24 June 2022|language=hr}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|first=Ken|last=Trahan|title=Pelicans take step forward, literally, in draft|url=https://crescentcitysports.com/pelicans-take-step-forward-literally-in-draft/|website=CrescentCitySports.com|date=23 June 2022|access-date=24 June 2022}}</ref> and on 23 July, he joined [[KK Cedevita Olimpija|Cedevita Olimpija]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Birali ga Pelikansi – stiže u Cedevita Olimpiju|url=https://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2022&mm=07&dd=23&nav_id=2188678|website=b92.net|date=23 July 2022|access-date=23 July 2022|language=Serbian}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Cedevita adds Matkovic to the mix|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/eurocup/news/cedevita-adds-matkovic-to-the-mix/?pageTitle=Homepage&historyUrl=/eurocup/|website=EuroleagueBasketball.net|date=23 July 2022|access-date=23 July 2022}}</ref>

On 4 February 2024, Matković left Cedevita.<ref>{{cite web|title=Karlo Matkovic officially leaves Cedevita Olimpija Ljubljana for the NBA|url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/eurocup/1623902/karlo-matkovic-new-orleans-pelicans-nba-cedevita-olimpija-ljubljana-bkt-eurocup/|website=EuroHoops.net|date=4 February 2024|access-date=4 February 2024}}</ref>

===New Orleans Pelicans / Birmingham Squadron (2024–present)===
On 22 February 2024, Matković joined the [[Birmingham Squadron]] of the [[NBA G League]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Birmingham Squadron Announce Addition of Karlo Matkovic|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/birmingham-squadron-announce-addition-of-karlo-matkovic/n-6059970|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=22 February 2024|access-date=22 February 2024}}</ref> and on 14 July, he signed with the New Orleans Pelicans.<ref>{{cite web|title=New Orleans Pelicans sign Karlo Matković|url=https://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/karlo-matkovic-jamal-cain-new-orleans-pelicans-roster-signings-free-agency-071424|website=NBA.com|date=14 July 2024|access-date=14 July 2024}}</ref> He made his NBA debut on 23 October, in a 123–111 win over the [[Chicago Bulls]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Chicago Bulls at New Orleans Pelicans Box Score, October 23, 2024|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/boxscores/202410230NOP.html|website=Basketball-Reference.com|access-date=1 November 2024}}</ref> Throughout his debut season, he has been [[NBA G League#Standard assignment|assigned]] several times to Birmingham.<ref>{{cite web|title=2024-2025 Birmingham Squadron Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Birmingham-Squadron/59/Transaction_History/2025|website=RealGM.com|access-date=28 January 2025}}</ref>

==National team career==
===Bosnia and Herzegovina===
Matković was born to a [[Croats of Bosnia and Herzegovina|Croat]] family in [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. He was a member of the [[Bosnia and Herzegovina men's national under-18 and under-19 basketball team|Bosnia and Herzegovina under-18 team]] at the [[2018 FIBA U18 European Championship]] in [[Latvia]]. Over seven tournament games, he averaged 8.6 points, 6.3 rebounds and 2.1 assists per game.<ref>{{cite web|title=U18 BH 2018 - Karlo MATKOVIĆ|url=http://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2018/player/Karlo-Matkovi%C4%87|website=FIBA.basketball|access-date=30 September 2020}}</ref> His team finished the last at the tournament with a 0–7 record.

===Croatia===
In November 2021, Matković expressed his interest to represent [[Croatia men's national basketball team|Croatia]] internationally in the senior competitions, if called.<ref>{{cite web|title=Hrvat koji igra u Beogradu odigrao senzacionalnu utakmicu! Ima samo 20 godina i želi dres Hrvatske|trans-title=Croat who plays in Belgrade played sensational match! He is only 20 and wants Croatian jersey|url=https://sportske.jutarnji.hr/sn/kosarka/aba-liga/hrvat-koji-igra-u-beogradu-odigrao-senzacionalnu-utakmicu-ima-samo-20-godina-i-zeli-dres-hrvatske-15117467|work=Sportske novosti|date=7 November 2021|access-date=10 November 2021|language=Croatian}}</ref> He made his debut for Croatia in February 2022, in the [[2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup qualification (Europe)#Qualifiers|2023 FIBA World Cup Qualifiers]] match against [[Sweden men's national basketball team|Sweden]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Nova bruka hrvatskih košarkaša: Damir Mulaomerović neuspješan na debiju|url=https://sportsport.ba/kosarka/hrvatska-poraz-svedska-damir-mulaomerovic/419586|website=SportSport.ba|date=25 February 2022|access-date=1 March 2022|language=hr}}</ref>
